$comment: SYNTHETIC transactions only. Payloads carry an internal member reference and nothing else - no names, no dates of birth, no SSNs, no wages. That is the rule for this domain, not a shortcut for the demo.

payload.$comment: BUSINESS EXCEPTION: plan code is not in the carrier catalog. No retry can add it.
SYSTEM EXCEPTION then RECOVERY: attempt 1 fails, attempt 2 succeeds. recover() is a no-op for sessionKind none - the retry itself is the recovery.
SYSTEM EXCEPTION, RETRIES EXHAUSTED: marked failed/system after maxRetries; the run continues.
